summary: Vilas County, WI tower (Trostel or Troste) that the FFLA lists as gone; mapcarta gives its town and elevation, and no source dates it or describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone by the Forest Fire Lookout Association, with no removal date or cause given

evidence.supports: listed as Trostel in Vilas County at 46.25243, -89.90834, status gone
OpenStreetMap node named Troste Lookout Tower
OpenStreetMap point coordinates, about 90 m from the FFLA point
tower is in the Town of Winchester, Vilas County
evidence.quote: Troste Lookout Tower is a tower in Town of Winchester

evidence.quote: Winchester is situated 2 miles south of Troste Lookout Tower.

sources.title: Troste Lookout Tower Map - Town of Winchester, Wisconsin

notes_for_editor: The FFLA list spells it Trostel; OpenStreetMap and Mapcarta use Troste. Mapcarta's page is based on OpenStreetMap, GeoNames and Wikidata, so its elevation is not an independent survey. A Facebook group post in Forgotten Wisconsin is titled 'Fire tower off Lake Adelaide in Winchester'. We could not open it, so we did not connect it to this tower; an editor could check whether it is the same site. No source gives a build date, design, height, or removal date, and no source describes the site now.
